name: Lawrence's Lopsided-Set Theorems
statement: Closed orthants met by a convex subset of $\mathbb R^X$ form a lopsided, hence ample, sign family. Lopsided families are closed under complements, nonempty cube-face sections, coordinate projections, and Cartesian products. They are exactly the totally asymmetric sign families, and every nonempty face section has a connected induced graph.
comments: Convex orthant realizability is sufficient but not necessary; the separate weakly convex realization theorem covers every ample family.
